key_safety.text: Most common adverse reactions (Study 1 / Study 2): nausea (56% / 86%), fatigue/asthenia (53% / 77%), infections (46% / 54%), vomiting (34% / 52%), anorexia (23% / 54%). Warnings include QT prolongation/ECG changes and hematologic toxicities (thrombocytopenia, leukopenia, anemia). Discontinuation due to AE occurred in 21% (Study 1) and 11% (Study 2).

citations.quote: Treatment with ISTODAX can cause thrombocytopenia, leukopenia (neutropenia and lymphopenia), and anemia; therefore, these hematologic parameters should be monitored during treatment with ISTODAX, and the dose should be modified, as necessary [See Dosage and Administration (2.2) and Adverse Reactions (6)].
Discontinuation due to an adverse event occurred in 21% of patients in Study 1 and 11% in Study 2.
